title: Eye color tendency

alleles.GG: Associated with lighter eyes, often blue, in European-ancestry populations.
alleles.AG: Mixed pigmentation signals; eye color cannot be determined from this marker alone.
alleles.AA: Associated with brown eyes in European-ancestry populations.

caveat: Eye color depends on multiple genes and ancestry. This is not a certainty.

title: Pigmentation tendency

alleles.AA: Associated with lighter skin pigmentation in several populations.
alleles.AG: One copy of a lighter-pigmentation-associated allele.
alleles.GG: Does not carry the A allele at this marker.

caveat: Cannot predict skin tone from one SNP; skin pigmentation is polygenic.

title: Earwax type
caveat: Genetic prediction is not a substitute for observation.

title: Lactose digestion

alleles.AA: More likely to keep digesting lactose as an adult.
alleles.AG: More likely to keep digesting lactose as an adult.
alleles.GG: Adult lactose digestion may be reduced, especially in European-ancestry populations.

caveat: Different populations have other lactase-persistence variants. Symptoms and clinical evaluation matter.

title: Caffeine processing

alleles.AA: Sometimes associated with faster caffeine metabolism under specific conditions.
alleles.AC: A single marker cannot reliably predict caffeine clearance.
alleles.CC: Sometimes associated with slower caffeine metabolism under specific conditions.

caveat: Medication, smoking, hormones and other genes can change CYP1A2 activity; do not calculate a safe dose from this marker.

title: Bitter taste marker

alleles.CC: One component of a bitter-taste-associated haplotype.
alleles.CG: One component of a bitter-taste-associated haplotype.
alleles.GG: One component of a bitter-taste-associated haplotype.

caveat: This SNP alone cannot determine taster status; full TAS2R38 haplotype and actual taste vary.

title: Fast-twitch muscle protein

alleles.CC: Predicted to produce functional alpha-actinin-3 protein.
alleles.CT: Predicted to produce functional alpha-actinin-3 protein.
alleles.TT: Predicted alpha-actinin-3 deficiency; a common, non-disease muscle protein variation.

evidence: Strong molecular effect; weak performance prediction
caveat: This does not predict strength, speed, endurance potential or training requirements.

title: Body weight association

alleles.AA: Two copies of an allele associated with slightly higher average BMI in some populations.
alleles.AT: One copy of an allele associated with slightly higher average BMI in some populations.
alleles.TT: No A allele at this marker.

evidence: Strong population association; low personal predictive value
caveat: Not a personal weight forecast or a reason to change diet or training.

title: Secretor status

alleles.GG: Likely secretor at this common marker.
alleles.AG: Likely secretor at this common marker.
alleles.AA: Likely nonsecretor at this common marker.

caveat: Other variants matter in some populations; does not determine whether you will get a stomach virus.

title: Sleep timing research

alleles.AA: This marker cannot reliably predict whether you are a morning or evening person.
alleles.AG: This marker cannot reliably predict whether you are a morning or evening person.
alleles.GG: This marker cannot reliably predict whether you are a morning or evening person.

caveat: Chronotype is polygenic and strongly affected by age, light and routine.

title: Cystic fibrosis — N1303K mutation

alleles.CC: N1303K alternate allele not observed at this marker.
alleles.CG: N1303K-associated alternate allele observed; clinical confirmation is essential.
alleles.GG: Two alternate alleles observed at this marker; seek clinical genetics assessment.

evidence: Clinically established variant; raw array unvalidated
caveat: Allele mapping must be checked against genome build and current clinical reference before any medical conclusion. This single site is NOT a comprehensive CF carrier screen. Never diagnose from raw data.
